name: Alf.io
description: Open source event ticketing and reservation platform for conferences and events.
composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      DATASOURCE_URL: "jdbc:postgresql://{{serviceName}}-postgres:5432/alfio"
      DATASOURCE_USERNAME: alfio
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      ALFIO_TEMPLATE_CACHE: {{env.ALFIO_TEMPLATE_CACHE}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/opt/alfio/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: alfio
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: alfio
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
